name: Vaults of the Inquisition: the Deceiver emerges and the Shadow Projections drop combat
contract: The Deceiver's Presence (162704) lies sealed under the ground until his Holy Crystals (162705) break: he keeps the invisible display 11686 while sealed and emerges (native display 138704) during the awakening sequence. A Shadow Projection (162748), the rooted tentacle in the walls, lashes players within 25 yd; dungeon creatures never leash by distance, so it kept its victim and the player stayed in combat after walking away. Expected: the boss is hidden a few seconds after spawning with no crystal nearby and shows his model before he wakes, and the player leaves combat once more than 25 yd from the tentacle.

steps.label: The sealed Deceiver is still under the ground
The tentacle engages the nearby player
Out of the tentacle's reach the player leaves combat
The Deceiver emerges with his own model
